title: AiVanceRecruiter
description: Talent acquisition professional and recruiter contact entity, detailing corporate affiliation, verified communication channels, statistical confidence scores, and verification methods.

id.description: Unique identifier for this recruiter contact

companyId.description: Foreign key reference to associated company in catalog

name.description: Full name of the recruiter or hiring manager

title.description: Official job title (e.g. 'Senior Technical Recruiter', 'Head of Engineering Talent')

department.description: Talent acquisition subdivision or engineering group (e.g., 'Infra & Platform Hiring')

verifiedContacts.description: Set of verified or synthesized contact endpoints with confidence scores

notes.description: User notes or interaction context regarding this recruiter

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when record was created

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when record was last updated

confidenceScore.description: Statistical confidence score (0 to 100) indicating email deliverability

verificationMethod.description: Method utilized to deduce or verify contact deliverability

isVerified.description: True if confirmed valid via SMTP ping or manual test

lastVerifiedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when contact deliverability was confirmed
